<function name="SetVelocity" parent="PhysObj" type="classfunc">

	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="velocity" type="Vector">The new velocity of the physics object in `source_unit/s`. (World frame)</arg>
	</args>
</function>
